::: {.intake-intro}
## LA PASSSTA Lab course entry form

The form opens on the University of Illinois Forms service. Form responses are collected there and are not copied into this GitHub Pages course. When Illinois Forms returns to this page with the completion indicator, the course stores only a browser-local marker that the entry step was completed; it does not store the form answers.
:::

::: {.review-note}
<strong>Privacy note:</strong> The public course does not require GitHub sign-in and does not upload your module progress, quiz selections, feedback, or certificate to the former course database. Review the [course and form privacy information](data-privacy.qmd) before continuing. Never enter participant names, health information, confidential information, or other sensitive data in the course.
:::
